name: Slingshot
author: supercleanse
description: Your newest downloads and screenshots, one click away. Slingshot puts a tray icon in the bar that drops down the latest files in your Downloads and Pictures folders, with thumbnails, and lets you drag any of them straight onto another app: drop on a terminal to paste the path, on a browser or chat app to attach the file, on a file manager to copy it. Click a file to copy it to the clipboard instead. The list refreshes itself as files arrive, and nothing polls while the dropdown is closed. An optional slingshot-ssh wrapper makes drops work over SSH too: the file is uploaded to the remote machine and its remote path is typed instead.

barWidget.description: Tray icon for your latest downloads and screenshots. Click it for the newest files in Downloads or Pictures, then drag one onto any app, or click it to copy. A dot appears when a new file lands.

schema.label: Show a dot when a new file arrives
